notes.title: New Hotfix to My Cozy Room!
notes.notes:
Dear Cozy Designers!

Thank you for your extremely helpful feedback! Listening to your requests, we have prepared for you a Hotfix 1.1 to My Cozy Room! 📢📢📢


What exactly will you find in the update? Firstly, to maximize your design experience, we have made improvements in cursor functionality🖱️.

We also tweaked the lighting, and for those who appreciate playing by their own rules, quietly 😌, we set the default ambient volume to 0 🔇, and lowered the volume of SFX 🔉.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45534162/fb93a7326e2fab6ae6282439d8a8d668f2f9485f.png"]

We're constantly taking in your feedback and working behind the scenes to implement as much as possible as quickly as possible. Thank you for your continued support! 🌞💞

We hope you will enjoy playing My Cozy Room even more now! 🛋️💖🧸
